_comment: The served set of the product site (ticket L0207, F4/F6/F81). tools/Build-SiteArtifact.ps1 copies exactly these files into the GitHub Pages artifact and .github/workflows/pages.yml deploys that artifact: anything not listed here is not on the site. `path` is repository-relative with forward slashes - 'folder/' is the whole folder, 'dir/*.ext' a file glob inside one folder ('**' crosses folders), 'dir/file.ext' one file. Every entry carries its reason. A reference from a served page to a file outside this list fails the assembly (it would be a 404 on the site): add the file here, or fix the reference. Run with -ReportUnreferenced to see served files that no page refers to.

include.reason: the root pages: landing, portal and guide pages, the old-address redirect stubs and 404.html
crawler policy and the sitemap address
the page list announced to search engines (generated by tools/Build-SitePages.ps1)
the machine-readable page index (generated by tools/Build-SitePages.ps1)
marker for a host that would run Jekyll; the Actions deploy runs none and upload-pages-artifact omits dotfiles by default, so it is harmless there
the 13 locale folders: the translated landing and trust pages
the task guides, the privacy policy, the Android publishing page and the docs index forwarder

the window help pages of the programs in 13 languages with their screenshots, and the shared exchange-mark art
